Mail Box Tags for Bommer Postal Units

text.description_html:
Cardboard Tags for Bommer Mailboxes

These cardboard tags are to be used with Bommer postal units. Great for labeling the name and/or the unit number on a set of mailboxes. Minimum purchase of 200 units.

Features and Specifications of the Bommer Mailbox Labels:

  • Material: Cardboard
  • Width: 2-1/16"
  • Height: 1-7/16"

200 Minimum - NO RETURNS
